annotations.summary: No container logs at all from ovh-prod
annotations.description: Total log volume from the prod host dropped to zero for the window. This is the coarse but unmissable outage signal: when the host wedged on 2026-09-06 dockerd stopped answering, every container stopped producing output and fluent-bit stopped shipping — and nothing said so. It also catches fluent-bit itself dying, the Tailscale path to the collector breaking, and a container stuck unhealthy with a dead main loop. Check: ssh the host, docker ps, docker logs ircfiber-fluent-bit --tail 50, tailscale status, and curl -fsS https://ircfiber.com/health from outside.
